title: Publish a one-number decision for each club, not a dashboard of counts
problem_it_solves: A reader cannot act on 347 injury rows. They can act on 'is this club missing more expected starters than its opponent, by how much, and is that number inside noise'.
proposal: One row per fixture: expected-starters-missing difference, the players named, and the interval around the difference. Blank until depth is verified.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: compare the difference with the settled result over >= 3 weeks

title: Show the sample size next to every rank
problem_it_solves: A rank at n=12 invites a bet a rank at n=12 does not support; the dashboard currently shows rank and hides n.
proposal: Every leaderboard row prints n_games, the 95% interval and the multiplicity-adjusted threshold in the same visual block as the rank.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: nothing - implemented in this pack on the settled leaderboard page

title: One pre-registration commit per strategy, with the hash printed on the page
problem_it_solves: Pre-registration exists as a CSV. A CSV can be edited after the fact; a commit hash cannot.
proposal: Each strategy's rule text is added in its own commit; the leaderboard prints that commit hash beside the strategy.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: re-derive that each printed hash predates its first forecast row

title: Treat the transactions table as the roster clock
problem_it_solves: The hub names a traded player at his old club (C-01); depth and availability tables go stale between transactions.
proposal: Every availability read is stamped with the latest transactions-table entry, and any hub row contradicting a trade is flagged automatically.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: zero unflagged mismatches over four consecutive reads

title: Score win probability and margin separately; never let one hide the other
problem_it_solves: A strategy can be well calibrated on winners and useless on margin. The repo's leaderboards mix the two.
proposal: Two panels per strategy: probability skill (Brier/log-loss with cluster interval) and margin error (mean absolute error vs a zero-margin line).
what_it_would_take_to_validate: margin panel exists only when an official line exists, otherwise blank

title: Log every capture attempt, including the failures
problem_it_solves: A blank cell currently says nothing about whether the page was absent, unreachable or empty.
proposal: A capture-attempt table with URL, clock, HTTP outcome and row count, published beside the data.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: each published table row traceable to an attempt row

title: Stop adding packs; consolidate before adding a fourteenth site
problem_it_solves: The repo now carries 20+ per-session sites with overlapping tables. Duplicate tables drift apart and a reader cannot tell which is current.
proposal: Freeze new packs for 30 days; make one index that names, for each dataset, the single current file and the date it was superseded.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: a duplicate-dataset audit listing every file that holds the same fact
review_state: proposed - needs owner decision before any deletion

title: Publish a 'do not bet this' state explicitly
problem_it_solves: Absence of evidence reads as approval. No strategy currently qualifies, and the site should say so in words, not just in empty cells.
proposal: A state banner computed from the gate register: if no strategy qualifies, the landing page prints 'no strategy qualifies; nothing here is a recommendation'.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: the banner flips automatically when a strategy clears its gates

title: Require a pre-declared ablation pair before any feature is trusted
problem_it_solves: Fixed point penalties for injuries are unfalsifiable. A paired ablation with a frozen holdout is falsifiable.
proposal: A feature ships only with an identical twin model without it, both scored chronologically, with the paired difference and its interval published.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: the interval excluding zero on a holdout never used for selection

title: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff, computed not typed
problem_it_solves: Static snapshots force the reader to remember last week's numbers.
proposal: The site diffs two dated captures and publishes rank/rating/availability deltas with the two read clocks.
what_it_would_take_to_validate: two dated captures of the same source existing in the repo
